# CANDIDATE: BULLISH_RSI_DIVERGENCE_WITH_BOS

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bullish RSI divergence combined with a bullish break of structure signals exhaustion of selling pressure and an imminent upward move. The RSI divergence indicates weakening momentum despite price making new lows, while the subsequent BOS confirms buyers have taken control. This combination should capture mean-reversion bounces in choppy markets where pure price-action signals fail.

## Mechanism

Compute RSI(14) on 5-minute bars. Identify bullish divergence when price makes a lower low while RSI makes a higher low within the last 10 bars. After divergence is confirmed, wait for a bullish BOS: price makes a higher high that surpasses the prior swing high (the high preceding the divergence low) with close above that high. Enter long at the close of the BOS bar. Exit: chart-stop at the swing low used in divergence identification, TP1 at 2.0R (risk = entry - stop), runner trail 15% off HWM after TP1. Only trade when ADX(14) < 20 and VIX < 20, and after 10:30 EST to avoid morning volatility noise.
